create.name: Michael Meade
create.bio:
Michael Meade is a storyteller and author who works with old myths, folk tales and poems as living material for the questions people face now. He draws on mythology, anthropology and psychology, and his central idea is that every person carries an inborn genius and a life story already seeded in the soul, which tends to show itself where people have been most hurt. In his telling, wounds and gifts sit close together, and times of loss or upheaval can become thresholds into a fuller sense of who one is.

He founded the Mosaic Multicultural Foundation, a non-profit through which he shares this work, and he hosts Living Myth, a weekly podcast with listeners in more than 150 countries. Among his books are The Genius Myth, Awakening the Soul, Fate and Destiny and, newest of all, The Heart of Transformation. He also offers recorded online courses on themes such as personal myth, rites of passage and the inner healer, along with free online talks and weekly written pieces. The foundation's mailing address is on Vashon Island in Washington State.
